description: Bruitages et musiques du monde Haras (dossier /11/ des cartes SD).

A distant horse neigh echoing in a pine forest, muffled, mysterious
An old metal door lock unlocking with a heavy click, then a wooden door creaking open
Birds chirping in a quiet pine forest, light breeze, early morning
Calm horse stable ambience, horses snorting and shuffling hay, distant hooves on concrete, birds outside, seamless loop
A single horse hoof hitting hard ground, one short sharp impact
Old landline telephone ringing twice in a quiet house
Short triumphant brass fanfare, equestrian competition victory, celebratory
Tense suspenseful music with fast galloping rhythm percussion, countdown feeling, seamless loop
Hurried footsteps of a woman in boots approaching on gravel
Short sad descending piano melody, failure ending
Short elegant hunting horn call followed by a horse whinny, countryside estate intro
Wind blowing through pine trees, creaking branches, damp forest after rain, seamless loop
Quiet old office ambience, ticking wall clock, faint electrical hum, seamless loop
Embers in a blacksmith forge flaring up after someone blows on them, soft whoosh and crackling fire
A horseshoe placed on a blacksmith anvil, then two ringing hammer strikes on hot metal, short
